finalText:
Build clean, exit 0.

Two real bugs, bundler bump caused both:

- `src/core/options.js` — read `options.retries`, new shape send `retryCount`. Crashed link stage.
- `src/net/retryPolicy.js` — strict boolean check threw on `undefined` (new loader leaves unset flags undefined, not `false`). Now just `=== true` check, defaults false.

Rest (8 warnings: DEP0142/0198/0233/0250/0267 deprecations, unused-export, circular-import) — noise, non-fatal, safe leave alone.
